Both changes are in the form, and it is valid.

- **Main colour:** set to dark green `#1B5E20`. The portal has assisted colour mode on, so I set it in the simplified colour field (Apparence > Thème par défaut, "Couleur principale"). Assisted mode recalculates the light, dark and high-contrast palettes when the draft is saved, so those may change. If you want a different text colour or background, you would need to turn assisted mode off first.
- **Menu:** added a "Page libre" item pointing to the existing page "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (slug `jeunesse`). It is the third item after Accueil and Catalogue de données. I left its label, target and icon empty, so the menu shows the page's own title.

Nothing is saved yet beyond what the form holds now, and I did not check the rendered portal.
